description: Rename a heading in a note and rewrite every [[note#heading]] wikilink and embed across the vault so references keep working — aliases preserved, fenced code blocks left alone. Served from the warm backlink index, no vault scan. Heading matching is case-insensitive; with duplicate headings the first match wins, mirroring Obsidian link resolution.

newHeading.description: New heading text, without # markers. Must not contain newlines, "[", "]", "|", or "#".

oldHeading.description: Current heading text, without # markers. Case-insensitive; first match wins.

path.description: Vault-relative path of the note containing the heading.

prevHash.description: Optional compare-and-swap guard: the contentHash from a prior read. Fails with hash_conflict if the note changed since.

name: rename_heading
